_finding: The paid-pass alarms (selling paused, a broadcast with no receipt, a settlement wallet out of gas) went only to the stp-web journal, which nobody reads (inventory 20.11). stp-health now turns /api/status.payments into Telegram alerts. The ways it goes quiet: a pause or low gas is never flagged, an unreadable balance reads as fine, or a late settlement is never sent (or sent every hour forever).

mutations.name: a pause is never flagged
mutations.expect: FAIL paused: an alert that says until when

mutations.name: low gas is never flagged
mutations.expect: FAIL gas below a day of settlements: an alert naming the wallet and the balance

mutations.name: an unreadable balance is silence
mutations.expect: FAIL a balance that cannot be read is an alert, never silence

mutations.name: late settlements are sent every hour for a day
mutations.expect: FAIL ...an hour later it is not sent again, and never "resolved": it is a task for a person

mutations.name: the RPC error reads as a zero balance
mutations.find: if (!j || typeof j.result !== 'string') throw new Error((j && j.error && j.error.message) || 'no balance in the answer')
mutations.expect: FAIL ...and an RPC error is an error, not a zero balance
